question: Can a fixed, one-scalar learned temporal recognizer tolerate a strictly monotone one-repeat/one-skip timing perturbation in otherwise correctly ordered sequences, while rejecting an unseen adjacent swap?
hypothesis: An alignment-aware, monotone single-repeat/skip candidate search may outperform raw position and raw transition mismatches under unseen positive warps, at higher but frozen analysis compute cost. All arms learn only a single scalar threshold.
source: Use same frozen W-R18 nonlinear 16-tick toy sequence, 9 entities/seed, development true jitter ((5*t+entity+seed)%3)-1 with +17 global candidate shift; heldout true jitter ((7*t+entity+seed)%5)-2 with +61 shift. Apply timing warp to entire shifted noisy candidate by repeating previous row at a single index and omitting that index's original row, keeping 16 ticks, anchor and monotonic source-index order.
development_pairs: All positives use warp at tick6 (copy tick5 to tick6). Negatives are same warped candidate followed by 15-row tail reversal on even entity, or rotation left3 on odd entity. First candidate row, candidate multiset and length are identical between matched positive/negative.
heldout_pairs: Positives use a new warp at tick9 (copy tick8 to tick9). Negatives swap tick11 and tick12 in the warped candidate (unseen training corruption).
arms: unordered histogram of anchor-relative modulo16 first-channel values, scalar train-only threshold
raw mean of 16 circular anchor-relative positional discrepancies, scalar threshold
raw mean of 15 transition discrepancies, scalar threshold
minimum mean circular anchor-relative difference over 15 preregistered monotone single-repeat/skip alignments (indices 1..15), scalar threshold; 16x15 bounded score computations, no trained new state
learning: For each arm one scalar trained from development-only max positive score and min negative score midpoint; same development sample count 72, no heldout labels/scores in calibration, no parameter tuning afterward.
classification: WARP_TRANSFER if monotone alignment >=0.85 heldout accuracy and unordered <=0.55 and monotone alignment strictly beats raw position; PARTIAL if monotone alignment beats both unordered and raw position but below threshold; NEGATIVE otherwise.
controls: Distinct new seed cohort, positive/negative multisets equal, per-tick jitters proven nonconstant, no heldout-derived warp search parameters, immutable Git blob identity, original artifact then one complete regression.
claim_limit: Synthetic monotone temporal alignment, not general language, semantics or accepted science promotion.
